english.title: Transport worker alcohol level over the limit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) worked on a

(A)_[railway]_
(B)_[tramway]_
(C)_[guided transport system specified by an order made by the Secretary of State]_

(D)_[as a driver]_
(E)_[as a guard]_
(F)_[as a conductor]_
(G)_[as a signalman ]_
(H)_[in a capacity in which you could control or affect the movement of a vehicle]_
(I)_[in a maintenance capacity]_
(J)_[as a supervisor of persons working in a maintenance capacity]_
(K)_[as a look-out for persons working in a maintenance capacity]_

after consuming so much alcohol that the proportion of it in your

(L)_[breath,]_
(M)_[blood,]_
(N)_[urine,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..)

(O)_[microgrammes of alcohol in 100 millilitres of breath,]_
(P)_[milligrammes of alcohol in 100 millilitres of blood,]_
(Q)_[milligrammes of alcohol in 100 millilitres of urine,]_

exceeded the prescribed limit
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 27(2) and 36(1) of the Transport and Works Act 1992.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also associated offence wordings H4370 and H4371 which relate to operators and employers.

other.powersofarrest: The offender would normally be in custody or hospital.
other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
